I work in the medical field (not a doctor tho) and the obese patients are 100% inconvenience :

Hard for the nurses that need to take care of their hygiene/bands etc (because heavy, often their hygiene is lackluster)

hard for the docs to obtain satisfactory blood analysis because their variables are often fucked up as well as their tension etc,

Hard for the team to pick them up from their bed to the stretcher (heavy as shit and often the patient can't really help because he/she's too heavy even for themselves), and route them to surgery block,

hard for the teams to have them go from the stretcher to the operation table,

hard for the anaesthetist to properly tube them and they require more cautious monitoring because they're more prone to embolies and oxygen desaturation and other shit related to high tension and clotted arteries,

hard for the team to position the patient optimally (they're fucking heavy and take too much space on the table: That's how you fuck your spine and get hernies and displaced disqus)

hard for the surgeon because he needs to cut through much more stuff,

hard for the surgeon again to have a clear view/space to access what he.needs to access,

hard for the nurses that have to put on extra length of bands on the sutured cut or have a leg that's heavier than their whole body on their shoulder to perform various end-of-operation tasks,

hard for the team to transfer back the patient from table to stretcher again and then to recovery room because they desaturate in oxygen so much faster that things have to be done faster than for normal BMI people.

Hard for the nurses on recovery room because they can't move the patient by themselves, they need to call orderlies as backup,

hard for the radio operator in recovery room for the same reason (can't put his sensitive plate under the patient if needed, need to call in backup that may already be busy), patient need to be monitored more cautiously again.

Hard again for the team to get the patient from stretcher to bed in his room (even harder this time because the patient is in no condition to do anything and now he/she is painful...)

Even harder for the nurse and care team to mend to the patient hygienic and medical needs after he returns from surgery to his bedroom.

I don't even want to know the shit the reeducative kine teams have to deal with...

Basically we, the overall medical staff and actors, generally resent obese patients because they make our day more stressful/painful.

Oh, and they cost more money to healthcare too.
